import unittest
from todo import add_todo, complete_todo


class TestTodo(unittest.TestCase):
    def setUp(self):
        """Create a fresh todo list for each test."""
        self.todos = []

    def test_add_todo_single_item(self):
        """Test adding a single todo item."""
        add_todo(self.todos, "Buy groceries")
        self.assertEqual(self.todos, ["Buy groceries"])

    def test_add_todo_multiple_items(self):
        """Test adding multiple todo items."""
        add_todo(self.todos, "Buy groceries")
        add_todo(self.todos, "Write code")
        add_todo(self.todos, "Exercise")
        self.assertEqual(self.todos, ["Buy groceries", "Write code", "Exercise"])

    def test_add_todo_returns_list(self):
        """Test that add_todo returns the updated list."""
        result = add_todo(self.todos, "Buy groceries")
        self.assertIs(result, self.todos)

    def test_complete_todo_removes_item(self):
        """Test that complete_todo removes the specified item."""
        add_todo(self.todos, "Task 1")
        add_todo(self.todos, "Task 2")
        add_todo(self.todos, "Task 3")
        complete_todo(self.todos, 1)
        self.assertEqual(self.todos, ["Task 1", "Task 3"])

    def test_complete_todo_first_item(self):
        """Test completing the first item."""
        add_todo(self.todos, "First")
        add_todo(self.todos, "Second")
        complete_todo(self.todos, 0)
        self.assertEqual(self.todos, ["Second"])

    def test_complete_todo_last_item(self):
        """Test completing the last item."""
        add_todo(self.todos, "First")
        add_todo(self.todos, "Last")
        complete_todo(self.todos, 1)
        self.assertEqual(self.todos, ["First"])

    def test_complete_todo_returns_list(self):
        """Test that complete_todo returns the updated list."""
        add_todo(self.todos, "Task")
        result = complete_todo(self.todos, 0)
        self.assertIs(result, self.todos)

    def test_complete_todo_invalid_index_raises_error(self):
        """Test that completing with invalid index raises IndexError."""
        add_todo(self.todos, "Task")
        with self.assertRaises(IndexError):
            complete_todo(self.todos, 5)

    def test_complete_todo_negative_index(self):
        """Test that negative indices work (Python list behavior)."""
        add_todo(self.todos, "First")
        add_todo(self.todos, "Last")
        complete_todo(self.todos, -1)  # Remove last item
        self.assertEqual(self.todos, ["First"])


if __name__ == "__main__":
    unittest.main()
